objective: Evaluate model sensitivity to feature selection, follow-up censoring thresholds, reverse conversions, and scanner/cohort eras

key_findings.interpretation: Excluding 39 non-converters censored between 640 and 729 days eliminates right-censoring ambiguity, raising combined AUROC to 0.8860 while confirming robust FreeSurfer incremental gain.

Removing functional and diagnostic-adjacent scales (CDR, FAQ) lowers clinical baseline from 0.8396 to 0.8119, but FreeSurfer morphometry compensates with an even larger incremental delta (+0.0496 vs +0.0391).
Model performance remains stable across varying clinical exclusion definitions, confirming that findings are not driven by rapid converters or fluctuating diagnostic boundaries.
